result.title: CLOSER: Evidence-Aware Active Visual Verification for Embodied Object-Goal Navigation
result.summary: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) requires an embodied agent to find an instance of a specified category in an unseen environment and stop near it. The agent typically relies on an object detector but must judge online from a limited egocentric video stream, sometimes a single frame, whether a detected candidate is the target. Detectors often confidently mistake similar objects, such as a sofa for a bed, and stopping at a false positive fails the episode. Prevailing systems also approach candidates greedily, leaving them occluded or partially observed. We present CLOSER, an evidence-aware active verification framework that treats stopping as closed-loop evidence acquisition, coupling vision-language model (VLM) verification with active perception. CLOSER fine-tunes an open-source VLM to label each view of a candidate tracked across frames as target, non-target, or uncertain, selects complementary views with an embedding-based diversity gate, and fuses their per-view probabilities with a lightweight network. If the fused judgment remains uncertain, a diffusion policy drives the agent toward the candidate using only the tracked mask and depth until the decision becomes decisive. CLOSER runs locally and plugs into existing ObjectNav systems without retraining them. On Gibson and Habitat-Matterport 3D, it raises average success rate by 3.6 points and success weighted by path length by 2.0 points, showing that verifying evidence before committing improves embodied navigation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CLOSER，把 ObjectNav 中的「停止」重构为闭环证据获取：微调开源 VLM 将候选目标各视角判为 target、non-target 或 uncertain，用嵌入多样性门控挑选互补视角并融合逐视角概率，若融合判断仍不确定，则由 diffusion policy 仅凭跟踪掩码和深度驱动智能体靠近观察，在 Gibson 与 HM3D 上提升成功率与 SPL。
AI.relevance_reason: 与「何时停止、是否继续获取视觉证据」的收益—成本问题直接相关，其不确定性触发的视角选择与主动趋近可供核查；但 VLM 只作逐视角判别器而非维护 latent 推理状态，是否触及 LVR 主线需读原文确认。
